name: Goapele
notes: The lane's quietest, most electronic-leaning 2000s entry. `confidence` is **low** because the research itself rates the entry medium-low and says outright that "the parametric detail is lane inference and marked accordingly" — only the era, the stated 68–96 band weighted to the slow end, and the stylistic position are sourced. What the entry does state drives the deltas: the drums are "programmed and soft — a filtered kick on 1 and 3, brushed or sampled snare on 2&4 mixed well down, sparse 16th hats, and long passages carried by a shaker alone", so the kick anchors are literally 1 and 3 at the lowest syncopation in the batch, the velocity tiers are the softest here, the hat is non-continuous, and the shaker is the densest lane. The harmony is "a single m9 or m11 sonority held under the whole verse, with the chord change reserved for the chorus" over "2-chord vamps of the `i–VI` or `i–iv` type over 4 bars" — the two families the entry writes out, at `maxChords` 2 with 8-to-16-beat durations. The low end is "sustained synth-sub or fretless-sounding electric bass on the root, long decay, minimal motion — the closest this section comes to a `trap-soul` low end, but without slides", which is `mirror_kick` at a root probability of 0.95 and a near-zero glide; it is deliberately **not** a `drums.bass808` block, because the entry describes a sustained synth bass rather than an 808, and authoring one would silence the bass generator. ⚠ Every drum, melody and countermelody number here is INFERRED from adjectives ("soft", "sparse", "breathy", "very low volume"). ⚠ **The bass is `mirror_kick` rather than the held `reese_sustain` the research describes** — *“sustained synth-sub or fretless-sounding electric bass on the root, long decay, minimal motion — the closest this section comes to a `trap-soul` low end, but without slides.”* — and that is a limit of the engine rather than a reading of the record. `generators::phrase_spans` re-articulates a held span only when it runs longer than two bars, so over the four-bar clip `reese_sustain` writes at most four notes and cannot reach the 500-bassline floor `engine/tests/bass.rs` holds every model to. `mobb-deep`, `dmx` and `capone-n-noreaga` carry the same substitution for the same reason; `followRootsProb` stays where it was so the line still reads as roots under the chord. ⚠ **`chords.harmonicRhythm` gained `syncopated_cell` (2026-08-17, harmony variety floor).** The entry says "a single m9 or m11 sonority held under the whole verse, with the chord change reserved for the chorus", over "2-chord vamps of the `i-VI` or `i-iv` type over 4 bars". `chordDurationBeats` is the only parameter carrying a loop length, and it was **dead here**: `generators::chords::layout` reads it under `syncopated_cell` alone, which this model did not author — so every generation was one 4-bar hold instead of the documented loop. The sonority itself does not move: over a single-chord family every cell is the same chord re-voiced. Both readings are the entry's: the held verse is `vamp` and the top of the authored [8, 16] cell range, and the 2-chord vamp over 4 bars is `2_bars_per_chord`. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 922/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.28 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. Second, `melody.densityPerBar` went from [1, 4] to [2, 5]. A lead allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves the counter almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter density recovers what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present rather than busier — the floor is what moved and the ceiling carries the density claim. ⚠ Every value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "pad-and-Rhodes bed with harp/bell arpeggios; 2-chord vamps of the `i–VI` or `i–iv` type over 4 bars. Melody is breathy alto-soprano at very low volume and low note-density, with airy multi-tracked stacks used as a texture rather than as harmony.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
